page_title: LAZ 0-0 NAP | Lazio v Napoli 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Luis Alberto (Lazio) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+5' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Leo Ostigard (Napoli).
90+3' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Pierluigi Gollini (Napoli).
90+3' Adam Marusic (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Matias Vecino (Lazio) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header low towards the middle of the goal, but Pierluigi Gollini is alert and denies him.
87' 36:64 – the ratio of ball possession.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) for Danilo Cataldi.
84' Here's the change. Gustav Isaksen leaves the pitch and Pedro (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.
84' Substitution. Piotr Zielinski is replaced by Leander Dendoncker (Napoli).
84' Walter Mazzarri has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
83' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
82' It must be a yellow card. It is. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
80' A substitution has been made. Mario Rui goes off and Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) comes on.
80' Substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) has come on for Giacomo Raspadori.
77' Here is a change. Matteo Guendouzi is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Matias Vecino (Lazio).
74' Mario Rui (Napoli) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) coming on for Manuel Lazzari.
70' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mario Gila (Lazio) was quite harsh and Daniele Orsato didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
65' Luis Alberto (Lazio) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
63' The ball is cleared after Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Walter Mazzarri decides to make a substitution. Diego Demme will be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli).
59' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
57' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Orsato and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' The ball is behind the touchline and Napoli will take a throw-in.

52' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Napoli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' Diego Demme (Napoli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
47' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
43' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
41' The resulting corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli) comes to nothing.
40' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
39' Mario Rui (Napoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Daniele Orsato couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Juan Jesus (Napoli) and blew his whistle.
35' Diego Demme (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
33' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
28' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
26' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' Wonderful movement by Napoli. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
20' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
18' Good movement by Leo Ostigard (Napoli), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
16' Matteo Politano (Napoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
14' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
12' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
10' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Orsato no option but to blow his whistle.
9' Luis Alberto (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
7' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
4' Adam Marusic (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
Daniele Orsato got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
